nodes.label: Requirements engineering workflow
nodes.rationale: Read CLAUDE and EngineRequirements; EngineRequirements is source of truth; requirements persistence requires explicit request.

nodes.label: Documentation authority and history
nodes.rationale: Requirements are durable authority; release details are separate; backlog files are historical or pending.

nodes.label: First release scope and historical status
nodes.rationale: Overview contains stale readiness statements: Undock absent and Load screen absent; consult newer specific documents and current implementation.

nodes.label: Mass limited cargo
nodes.rationale: Cargo quantity is integer; mass=quantity*unitMassKg; Energy Cells consume cargo capacity; Fuel belongs to engine tanks.

nodes.label: Module addressed command panels
nodes.rationale: Six panels include Torpedo Launcher and Countermeasure Launcher; Client exposes authoritative command states and assigned operators.

nodes.label: Crew and cabin capacity
nodes.rationale: Two EP-0007 operators occupy both starting cabins; passenger admission requires free capacity; crew persists and consumes food.

nodes.label: Linear crew dialogues
nodes.rationale: Dialogues are modal and pause simulation; document still describes protagonist-only start, unlike later two-operator requirement.

nodes.label: MVP reactor energy
nodes.rationale: One Energy Cell per calendar game hour; active modules require running reactor; detailed power allocation and batteries excluded.

nodes.label: Fuel tank and route cost separation
nodes.rationale: Fuel stored only in engine tanks; baseline module commands do not consume fuel; route fuel cost is a separate authoritative mechanic.

nodes.label: Finite deterministic ice mining
nodes.rationale: Drilling Unit purchased separately; scan, synchronization and <=100 km required; finite 100..5000 stock, 100..200 extraction each 10000 ms, limited by cargo.

nodes.label: Integer market budgets and Tokens
nodes.rationale: Credits internal name, Tokens displayed; scenario playerTokens starts at 2000; hidden station budgets and market revisions persist; partial sale permitted.

nodes.label: Passenger contract capacity gate
nodes.rationale: Both starting cabins occupied after EP-0007; accepted passengers/contracts are authoritative persisted entities.

nodes.label: Docked station representative dialogue
nodes.rationale: Station trade agent uses same linear modal dialogue format as crew; requires docked player and available representative.

nodes.label: Finite local market inventory
nodes.rationale: Save budgets/stocks/events/revisions without duplicate intervals; unit trade replaces obsolete packages; stale quote rejected; no tank fuel resale.

nodes.label: Tetrarch hull and loadout
nodes.rationale: 9x9 hull has 12 structural cells and 8 modules; separate torpedo and countermeasure operators; no starting drill.

nodes.label: Local market trade concept
nodes.rationale: Reuse existing TradeScreen and Station flow; no parallel client market computation or separate sector-market screen.

nodes.label: Economic graph before geography
nodes.rationale: Historical five-station MVP creates connected production-consumption graph and at least two cycles before geometry; solar concept expands counts.

nodes.label: Cargo screen requirements
nodes.rationale: Planned screen: Energy Cells occupy cargo, Fuel lives only in engine tanks.

nodes.label: Character Communication screen requirements
nodes.rationale: Planned character list opens linear Dialog and is reachable from Ship or Session.

nodes.label: Contracts passenger modal
nodes.rationale: Implemented navigation/pause shell only; accepting passenger contracts requires a free cabin and remains unimplemented in this document.

nodes.label: Dialog screen historical requirements
nodes.rationale: Document calls generic linear-dialog screen unimplemented; DialoguePortraits later describes an active DialogueScreen.

nodes.label: Finance screen requirements
nodes.rationale: Modal placeholder; authoritative financial journal supplies player credits and voyage profit. Exact station credits stay hidden; Client must not recompute economics.

nodes.label: GameMenu modal
nodes.rationale: SkiaWindow owns modal pause and the single dim overlay; opening freezes game time, cycles, mining, trading and fuel consumption and closing restores prior speed.

nodes.label: Hire crew modal
nodes.rationale: Crew hiring is entirely outside first release; separate Contracts handles MVP passenger contracts.

nodes.label: Loot screen requirements
nodes.rationale: Planned ice-mining loot transfer must respect finite cargo capacity.

nodes.label: MainMenu entry flow
nodes.rationale: New Game opens scenario selection without creating session. Menu has no direct Engine dependency; document says Load button disabled.

nodes.label: ScenarioSelect factory boundary
nodes.rationale: Lists scenarios through factory, skips invalid JSON, creates selected scenario only on Play. Generated masterSeed deterministically initializes missing economy network; no direct Engine dependency.

nodes.label: Screen Catalog and historical status table
nodes.rationale: Target Screen{Name} naming; mechanics panels 1400x800 and shared close behavior. Table contains stale status assertions for Load, Ship and dialogue.

nodes.label: Settings presentation isolation
nodes.rationale: UI scale changes panels only, never map coordinates, object hit-testing or simulation.

nodes.label: Ship screen requirements
nodes.rationale: Describes unimplemented Tetrarch/crew/cabin/module overview and transition to Character Communication; catalog instead records a modal stub.

nodes.label: Station docked hub
nodes.rationale: Only Engine-confirmed dock enables hub. Actions pass through IGameSessionConnection and modal pause. Closing preserves docking; Undock sends authoritative command.

nodes.label: Trade local market screen
nodes.rationale: Reuses existing screen with authoritative quotes and CommandId result reconciliation. Buy/Sell cargo use container, fuel refills engine only. Unit trading explicitly replaces package multiples.

nodes.label: Screen naming refactor specification
nodes.rationale: Planned Screen{Name} rename covers files, folders, namespaces, tests and references, excludes IScreen and avoids behavior changes or new-screen work.

nodes.label: Station economy production and sizing specification
nodes.rationale: Deterministic five-role connected market, finite stocks/budgets, explicit scenario priority, fixed-point sequential quotes, revisions, timed events and save/load without replay.

nodes.label: Current dialogue portrait composition
nodes.rationale: W4/M4 full canvas heads and costumes compose to 300x300; seed/character identity selection persists resolved paths, legacy W/M maps stably without rewriting saves.

nodes.label: Female facial proportions reference
nodes.rationale: Artistic proportional canons are approximate, not universal aesthetic constraints. Whole portrait silhouette retained; registered detail pixels compose by SrcOver without geometric distortion.

nodes.label: Legacy W modular portrait generator
nodes.rationale: Current default is whole-portrait W4; historical W v10 stores registered layers, supports v4-v10 presets and rejects v1-v3. Preparation is offline; game performs no AI calls or geometry changes.

nodes.label: Modal pause ownership
nodes.rationale: Single SkiaWindow mechanism freezes authoritative simulation while UI continues and restores previous speed.

nodes.label: UI scale isolation
nodes.rationale: Presentation scaling must not alter map geometry, hit testing or simulation.

nodes.label: Unit trading supersedes package quantities
nodes.rationale: Any category trades single units. Removed 100-resource/10-good constraints and package-rounded partial sale.

nodes.label: MarketRevision quote validity
nodes.rationale: Stale quote or failed command leaves state unchanged; validate money, stock, station budget, capacity and idempotency.

nodes.label: Stable economic interval ordering
nodes.rationale: Finish/start events, produce, consume, external profile flows, clamp stock/budget, classify stock, revise quotes, publish snapshot; same order at every time speed.

nodes.label: Stable persisted portrait identity
nodes.rationale: Persist resolved relative path so later catalog additions do not change saved faces; missing explicit PNG produces empty image without crash.

nodes.label: Male M4 portraits use filename-stable IDs and separate presets
nodes.rationale: Whole transparent 1024x1024 head and neck composes under shared W4 costumes; renaming used files breaks presets.

nodes.label: Historical W1 oval, whole face, costume, hair layers
nodes.rationale: W1 remains explicitly selectable; W4 is the default. Source and Generated assets are excluded from delivery.

nodes.label: Historical W2 common neck, whole head, costume, hair layers
nodes.rationale: W2 remains explicitly selectable; W4 is the default; 45 combinations preserve head identity.

nodes.label: W4 portrait and costume composition
nodes.rationale: PNG discovery is case-insensitive and shallow. New assets use Character Generator; legacy UnifiedPortraitAssets layout is obsolete.

nodes.label: Tactical active asset means hover
nodes.rationale: Commands use 64px assets at 48px; names are loader contracts; Xenon header toggles are separate resources.

nodes.label: Approach v3 shortest intercept then fixed rear-point fallback
nodes.rationale: Tests for all six Dubins families preserve constant speed. Faster/equal targets may be intercepted; no obstacle avoidance or variable-speed control is added.

nodes.label: Client renders confirmed ApproachRoute and exact terminal pose
nodes.rationale: Viewport continuation is visual course projection, not additional command geometry or guaranteed pursuit; IsRendezvous determines encounter marker.

nodes.label: EP-0006 automated proof with native acceptance not run
nodes.rationale: Historical first-stage combat evidence; later EP7 changes loadout/chance/trails. Raster tests do not prove native GPU behavior.

nodes.label: Real combat proof uses production scenario and real commands
nodes.rationale: No HP edits, teleportation or mock snapshots; checks time partition invariance, true file continuation and real UI transport.

nodes.label: Ten September review defects corrected
nodes.rationale: Common RuntimeMotion.At handles Approach; exact double motion persists; receipts and mailbox histories are bounded at 4096; preflight validation preserves world.

nodes.label: September reviewed defects are historical findings
nodes.rationale: Six defects reproduced at revision 4bc95df; later Fixes.md records corrections. Architectural decomposition remains recommendations, not all implemented.

nodes.label: Countermeasure defense uses frozen ratings and physical deadlines
nodes.rationale: Chance is rounded tenths; separate combat.countermeasure.intercept.v1 SplitMix64 stream; zero chance consumes no launch/RNG; physical pause blocks auto launch.

nodes.label: Save v11 defense payload and legacy provenance
nodes.rationale: Validate IDs, phase, route, ratings, RNG before live replacement; legacy saves do not invent assigned operators or replay outcomes.

nodes.label: Countermeasure trail and combat journal projection
nodes.rationale: Countermeasure trails remain visible; ordinary torpedo trails are hidden. Effects use two real monotonic seconds; loading clears transient replay.

nodes.label: Catalog schema v2 economic fingerprint and save compatibility
nodes.rationale: Catalog version and save format are separate; SHA256 covers economic fields, not names/order; legacy fingerprint must not be recalculated automatically.

nodes.label: September physical zoom presets and LOD replace old hide-by-scale policy
nodes.rationale: World unit stays 100m. Presets 1,0.1,0.001,0.0001,0.00001 PPU; wheel reaches 1e-12. All contacts persist with clustering and knowledge-safe LOD.

nodes.label: Camera fit uses free viewport and client-visible system geometry
nodes.rationale: Follow zoom anchors ship; free zoom anchors cursor; UI consumes wheel. Commands fit once and cannot reveal unknown type through bounds.

nodes.label: Historical CPU raster benchmark is not current planner or GPU evidence
nodes.rationale: Approach v3 requires new comparable baseline; old 502-object reports measure CPU raster costs, not presented FPS.

nodes.label: Changing path-mask cache plus blurred dashed forecast caused GPU stalls
nodes.rationale: Disable path-mask caching and replace blur with two strokes; cache reticle glow; explicit swap telemetry separates CPU work from presentation wait.

nodes.label: High precision scaled time and RenderMotion smooth x100 presentation
nodes.rationale: Scale before rounding; use common Stopwatch; reconcile 300ms real-time corrections and reuse value poses without copying snapshots.

nodes.label: Trade UI uses one catalogue, explicit storage and authoritative receipts
nodes.rationale: Preserves station toolbar; no economic rule changes. Pending blocks duplicates; actual partial sell and errors come from Engine.

nodes.label: Historical discrepancy tasks specify deterministic seeds and strict content
nodes.rationale: New Game seed immutable and persisted; thematic JSON must validate before immutable registry publication.

nodes.label: Historical backlog hides asteroids/NPC at large map scales
nodes.rationale: Superseded by implemented September LOD; do not reintroduce object disappearance from old backlog.

nodes.label: Historical tasks preserve Engine authority and dependency-free immutable Contracts
nodes.rationale: Descriptions of missing implementations reflect August baseline, not current code.

nodes.label: Historical nine-module twelve-cell starting ship
nodes.rationale: Later EP7 documents eight modules and two operators; historical task is not current loadout authority.

nodes.label: Match commands capture explicit authoritative target speed/course
nodes.rationale: UI selection is not an implicit authoritative target; missing/unknown targets rejected.

nodes.label: PortraitAssets development-only tool
nodes.rationale: Uses Client renderer to prepare and validate PNG/JSON layers offline. Client does not depend on or launch it; sources, previews and golden references are excluded from client package.

nodes.label: Tactical button and combat UI tooling
nodes.rationale: 43 PNG button assets retain filenames/dimensions; active suffix denotes hover. EP-0007 uses snapshot projection, six command groups and frozen breakdown.

nodes.label: CombatEffectStore load watermark
nodes.rationale: Separates authoritative physical state from monotonic effect lifetime and sets watermark after load.

nodes.label: World scale follows starting ship Vmax and physical/calendar separation
nodes.rationale: Player-to-Sun distance equals 50–75 calendar days at actual initial maximum speed, accounting for docking offset; calendar factor300 and 100m world units remain unchanged.

nodes.label: EP2 owns shared generation, orbit, time and save contracts
nodes.rationale: Engine owns world, Motion common mathematics, Contracts serialized data and Client rendering. EP3/EP4 extend the same generator/map; Load preserves resolved world without regeneration.

nodes.label: EP2 historical acceptance does not certify final EP4 layers
nodes.rationale: October addendum explicitly reuses delivered solar/orbit/save contracts while keeping historical acceptance separate from current full-layer measurements.

nodes.label: Human clusters preserve economic identity and compact motion
nodes.rationale: Default3–5 clusters with10–12 stations and five economic profiles. Human scientific-military is not AI; common angular organization preserves internal distances; initial travel ranges are tuning, not eternal moving-target ETA.

nodes.label: EP1 owns economy while EP3 owns trading geography
nodes.rationale: Known map gives neither remote trade nor fresh quotes. Existing prices, stock, production, budgets and voyage lifecycle remain EP1 responsibilities; graph connectivity alone does not prove profit.

nodes.label: EP3 hands human geography and links to EP4
nodes.rationale: EP4 must recheck geometric detours while preserving local cluster compactness.

nodes.label: EP4 preserves delivered human/resource continuation contracts
nodes.rationale: AI stations are excluded from human cluster membership; EP3 historical acceptance and balance scope are not widened.

nodes.label: EP4 implementation delivered; native80FPS acceptance OPEN
nodes.rationale: Current composition9 stories/26 tickets. Recorded3884/3884 tests and8/8 native interactions pass, but target80FPS fails; US8TK3 remains in_progress. Measurements are complete without full epic acceptance.

nodes.label: AI territories and environmental fields are informational
nodes.rationale: Future patrol radii do not spawn patrols, attacks, damage, interception, consumption or movement restrictions. Radiation/dust/debris do not affect sensors, prices or collisions; POI inspection creates no exploration rewards.

nodes.label: Trade-compatible AI geography has a finite365-day horizon
nodes.rationale: Preserve start/local trade and connected geometric detours; check named and critical epochs with bounded deterministic retries. This reserves space without an autopilot or eternal safety guarantee.

nodes.label: Authoritative full spatial knowledge preserves gameplay access boundaries
nodes.rationale: All bases, owners, radii, fields, intensities and POIs known from start. World exists separately from knowledge; remote price freshness and trade access are unchanged. Selected marker/UI readability is required across layers.

nodes.label: Materialized map environment continues without regeneration
nodes.rationale: Persist identity, owner/base links, orbit anchors, geometry, radii, intensity and decoration data using EP2/EP3 contracts. No second orbit model or per-frame copy of complete geometry.

nodes.label: Patrol combat, effects, diplomacy and exploration remain future scope
nodes.rationale: First-stage information is not partial combat via random damage; existing market events remain active without new geographic hooks.

nodes.label: Distinct known AI bases with authoritative hostile access
nodes.rationale: Requires delivered EP2 known map and EP3 distinct clusters. Planetary bases follow planets; free bases follow orbit. Owner identity is independent of scientific-military profile or display color.

nodes.label: US1 five tickets and self-review completed
nodes.rationale: Reported DTO, seeded movement/save, malformed-input atomicity and all dock/trade bypass regressions passed. Early native NOT RUN is historical and points to consolidated US8.

nodes.label: AiBaseMapData and optional AiMapEnvironmentSnapshot
nodes.rationale: Descriptor carries objectId,type,owner,parent-or-own-orbit and offsets. Owner Ai; Planetary/Orbital. Explicit camelCase and default-safe immutable arrays retain absent-block compatibility.

nodes.label: October resolved contract supersedes copied dependency signatures
nodes.rationale: SaveFormat15, AiMap rulesVersion1, six scenarios and inline poiTemplates are current. Field/POI metadata are neither runtime entities nor command targets;80FPS remains OPEN.

nodes.label: Detached AI generation after human clusters
nodes.rationale: Named ai/counts and ai/placement streams create stable IDs and a strict subset of planets plus own-orbit bases. No market profiles, stocks or producers. Validate descriptors before excluding AI from human membership; fix empty-stock fallback.

nodes.label: Bounded deterministic AI count and attempt limits
nodes.rationale: Count2..1024, attempts1..4096 are engineering caps; default2..4 unchanged. Parent orbit uses shared Motion; malformed owner/parent/ID fails before replacing world.

nodes.label: Owner-based station_access_denied protects every dock/trade entry
nodes.rationale: IsAiBase gates direct Dock, repeated dialogue validation, quote and legacy/quoted buy/sell/refuel, plus docked projection. GrantStationAccess cannot override owner; crafted docking/stale quotes leave money/cargo/fuel/markets/ledgers unchanged.

nodes.label: Shipped AI defaults2–4 bases,200/1000km,64 attempts
nodes.rationale: Actual factory matrix covers all six scenarios, seeds1/2/42 and count2/4; human states match no-AI controls. Total station counts distinguish human cluster members from AI.

nodes.label: Legacy fixture assertions explicitly account for AI entities
nodes.rationale: Synthetic removal of map clears AiMap too; MasterSeed count includes AiMap.Bases. Corrections were separate commits, preserving human completeness rather than weakening assertions.

nodes.label: Selectable AI diamond glyph and descriptor-driven access display
nodes.rationale: AI markers survive coarse clustering; planet/free symbols and text supplement color. Real hit-test can select base coincident with planet; human scientific-military with Enemy color is not AI.

nodes.label: Two moving informational radii retain independent base owners
nodes.rationale: Overlap has a union appearance but each base remains identifiable. No gameplay effects; long-horizon detour proof belongs to US3.

nodes.label: US2 three tickets and story self-review completed
nodes.rationale: DTO/zoom/raster, pose/pause/calendar continuation, radius validation, initial network exclusion and no-effects regressions passed; early native deferral remains historical.

nodes.label: TerritoryMapData stores radii and BaseObjectId
nodes.rationale: Finite0<DefenceRadiusKm<=PatrolRadiusKm; each overlapping zone retains its ID and owner. Optional Territories defaults empty; centers are derived from base pose, not camera.

nodes.label: AI-only retries keep initial player and full local segments outside
nodes.rationale: Check stations and complete route segments, not endpoints alone; tangency blocked. Center uses shared-Motion base position and equal-time control confirms no gameplay state changes.

nodes.label: World-scaled moving radii use union fill without alpha stacking
nodes.rationale: radiusKm*10 and predicted base pose define geometry. Per-base contours/selection remain; text describes future patrols without promising attacks.

nodes.label: Bounded critical-epoch and local interval clearance validation
nodes.rationale: 365 calendar days; physical time=calendar/300. All human local nodes/routes get conservative interval proof; player only at generation. Intercluster visibility connectivity is sampled at named/critical epochs and is not continuous autopilot.

nodes.label: Conservative64-vertex detours with Sun/system bounds
nodes.rationale: Sun exclusion=max(1 world,1% system radius), epsilon1e-6, tangency blocked. Work bounded by8192epochs,100000subdivisions,depth32,200000checks,8192nodes and2000000edgechecks per epoch. Exhausted or uncertain means invalid.

nodes.label: Placement diagnostics belong to each Engine instance
nodes.rationale: Immutable last successful result is published only in atomic world lock and exposed read-only to Performance friend. Shared static last-result would mix parallel worlds; failed generation preserves previous world/diagnostics.

nodes.label: Production --ai-placement exposes reproducible geometric evidence
nodes.rationale: Requires --clusters; selected min/max boundaries include AI count. --clusters-only keeps eight-boundary pre-AI baseline. Raw checks and deterministic geometry separated from timing; production validator reused.

nodes.label: Streaming per-world spool avoids1.3GB report-string allocation
nodes.rationale: Reported600worlds,6044448checks,492critical epochs, all components1; timings overlapped regression and are not performance acceptance. Full corpus reproduced OOM, fixed through streaming and closing exclusive spool writer before read.

nodes.label: US3 finite-horizon placement and evidence completed
nodes.rationale: Engine1774/1774 and final non-corpus1675/1675, tooling6/6 reported passed. Self-review and corpus validate stated finite geometry only; no balance/native/performance acceptance inferred.

nodes.label: Radiation, dust and debris are known informational geometry
nodes.rationale: Fields follow Parent/Orbit or Sun-center rules, preserve world bounds and reveal intensity without damage, consumption, sensor degradation, collisions, movement blocks or price changes.

nodes.label: US4 no-effects comparison includes moving ship and market events
nodes.rationale: 48h control compares full snapshots/save excluding descriptors. Pattern/selection/edge regressions found and fixed two UI defects; native/all-layer gate remains US8.

nodes.label: EnvironmentFieldData describes circle or annular sector
nodes.rationale: Kind Radiation/Dust/Debris; AnchorKind Parent/Orbit/Sun; intensity[0,1],0<=inner<outer,sweep(0,360],world dimensions and clockwise-zero-up angles. Exact decoration seed; no gameplay modifiers.

nodes.label: Per-kind seeded metadata stages create no SpaceObjects
nodes.rationale: Fields follow validated AI stage without altering earlier generation. Parents reference real SpaceObjects only; one-of/geometry/case-duplicate validation is atomic. Counts0..64 per kind, dust width clipped to selected belt.

nodes.label: Sun anchor means stationary center; dust sector need not be axisymmetric
nodes.rationale: Radiation is Sun-centered axisymmetric circle; dust stationary Sun-centered belt sector; debris alternates real-parent and own-orbit anchors. Shared math plus offsets defines placement.

nodes.label: Shipped environment1radiation/2dust/2debris with intensity0.5
nodes.rationale: Dimensions5000/100/250km; six-scenario actual factory tests preserve IDs and no-entity behavior. Strict loader rejects hidden damage/price/sensor/fuel properties.

nodes.label: Patterned fields use authoritative clipped geometry and cached decoration
nodes.rationale: Rings/hatching/triangles distinguish types without color. ID/seed/sample cache evicted when descriptor removed; parent/own-orbit positions use shared mathematics. Angular0/360 edge tolerance and empty-module crash fixed by regressions.

nodes.label: Field inspection is UI-only and protects real command targets
nodes.rationale: Retains valid real selection while disabling object-target commands at display and send time; real-marker click clears inspection, right-click clears both. Ctrl+Click navigation remains available; planet markers render above overlays.

nodes.label: Known abandoned POIs retain resource identity without exploration effects
nodes.rationale: Selectable names/descriptions and repeatable identity/location; EP3 resource IDs/composition/anchors retained without duplicate fields or automatic stock mining.

nodes.label: US5 automated story acceptance completed through metadata-only POIs
nodes.rationale: Immutable DTO, seeded no-entity generator, strict content and real renderer/input tests reported passing; implementer self-review is not independent approval and early native deferral is historical.

nodes.label: Current EP4 contract supersedes planning inputs
nodes.rationale: Retained plan is traceability only: SaveFormat15, AiMap rulesVersion1, six scenarios, inline poiTemplates. Field and POI descriptors are not entities or Engine command targets. Historical NOT RUN does not supersede final native evidence; FPS80 remains OPEN.

nodes.label: Deterministic POI placement
nodes.rationale: Templates are ordered by ID, assigned SYS-POI-{ordinal}, and use isolated per-template named streams after environment generation. Prefer canonical resource asteroid parents plus small offsets; otherwise a circular belt orbit. No extra SpaceObjects or economy/event hooks.

nodes.label: Strict POI ingress
nodes.rationale: Optional 0..128 templates require case-insensitive unique IDs and nonblank text. Global namespace, finite offsets and one-of references validate before publication; only SpaceObject parents prevent descriptor cycles. ScenarioLoader replaced read-only SolarSystemGenerator in resolved five-file scope.

nodes.label: POI no gameplay effects evidence
nodes.rationale: Dated evidence reports targeted 4/4 and Engine non-corpus 1682/1682 PASS. An actual visit and rejected fake object selection compare equal-time snapshots and saves, preserving resources, markets and receipts.

nodes.label: Abandoned relay and platform content
nodes.rationale: Two inline templates give known Russian names/descriptions explaining unavailable exploration/actions. Strict content rejects rewards, cost and production properties.

nodes.label: Six scenario POI content execution
nodes.rationale: All six shipped scenarios resolve two descriptors without SpaceObjects; strict loader rejects reward/cost/production/actions; Client1749/1749 passed.

nodes.label: Local POI inspection
nodes.rationale: POI ID is selected locally without SelectObject; only real object IDs remain game command targets. Separate marker and info panel do not use Station type or open Trade. Existing resource renderer joins canonical IDs without duplicating fields.

nodes.rationale: Hexagonal markers use shared parent/motion prediction. Wrapped name/description and unavailable exploration notice are shown; real selection is preserved and object commands disabled during descriptor inspection. Named3/3 and Client1752/1752 passed.

nodes.label: Readable layers acceptance
nodes.rationale: Min/max configuration must preserve UI access and overlapped selection, readable owner/radii/type/intensity, authoritative map knowledge and unchanged quotes. Composition stays on the existing map; domain clusters are not screen aggregation.

nodes.label: US6 self review evidence
nodes.rationale: Client1755/1755 passed after compact panel and toolbar repairs; pre-US8 native/manual NOT RUN is historical, not the final native state.

nodes.label: MapLayerFlags
nodes.rationale: Client-only Orbits/Territories/Fields/PointsOfInterest default on. Hidden layers remove their hit tests but preserve real selection and world/knowledge/quotes.

nodes.label: Deterministic overlap selection
nodes.rationale: Repeated clicks within 3 screen pixels cycle a stable visible list: station, player, NPC, other object, POI, field. Moving outside tolerance or changing visible IDs resets the cycle; descriptor labels remain readable.

nodes.label: Responsive full map controls
nodes.rationale: The reproduced1280x720/UI150 panel covered744x648physical pixels. Scope expanded to six files; responsive width/image, two scrolling rows, reserved map space and wrapped toolbar repaired usability. Legacy maps retain toolbar layout. Matrix1280/1920 and UI100/120/150 passed.

nodes.label: Resolved map continuation acceptance
nodes.rationale: Save/load must preserve IDs, ownership, independent overlapping contributions, radii, geometry, intensity, anchors, phase, decoration and markets. Loading cannot regenerate layers.

nodes.label: US7 persistence self review
nodes.rationale: JSON and real local-file/factory coverage passed; optionalDTO15 compatibility retains absent aiMap. Territory-link namespace defect repaired, Engine1689/1689 non-corpus passed; US8 later owns full corpus/native evidence.

nodes.label: SaveFormat15 optional AiMap
nodes.rationale: Earlier additive save/snapshot wiring is reused. SaveFormat stays15, absence is compatible, aiMap.rulesVersion is separately strict; no independent migration.

nodes.label: Atomic AiMap restoration
nodes.rationale: Serialize resolved map fully and restore without generators. Invalid unique IDs, anchors, radii, intensity, parent/base owners, cycles and future formats fail before publication. Old solar/cluster saves remain without aiMap.

nodes.label: Save continuation execution
nodes.rationale: Actual quote/trade/voyage/arrival/sell preserves complete map and finance through JSON. Epochs0/1/30/365days, overlapping territories, parent/own-orbit fields, decoration/POI survive; generation config is ignored on load. Nineteen malformed cases/future version reject atomically; case-insensitive territory versus cluster-link collision repaired. Named3/3 and Engine1685/1685 passed.

nodes.label: LocalGameSessionConnection file continuation
nodes.rationale: Real Save/Load matrix covers travel, dock and pause. Engine explicit-time seam under Speed0 avoids unsynchronized wall-clock comparisons; public factory check uses paused snapshot and unchanged file.

nodes.label: Local factory atomic publication evidence
nodes.rationale: SaveAsync writes actual slot and public factory restores paused full map/time/voyage. Broken parent prevents publication and file rewriting. Next explicit-time step and quoted sell match finance/markets. Named4/4, Engine1689/1689 passed, production/reference unchanged.

nodes.label: Full map evidence acceptance
nodes.rationale: At least100fixedseeds, all scenarios and min/max configuration with independent correctness, invalid placement/radii and no side effects. Generation/snapshot/save and frame interaction measurements require hardware and80FPS goal; unspecified budgets remain unassessed.

nodes.label: US8 acceptance remains open
nodes.rationale: Correctness and600+600world comparison delivered; automated checks and8/8native interaction pass. FPS80 measured FAILED, so story remains in_progress although no confirmed functional issue remains.

nodes.label: Independent full map corpus
nodes.rationale: The matrix contains 100 seeds × 6 scenarios × 2 boundaries = 1200 primary worlds. Boundaries are clusters 3/5, stations 10/12, planets 3/7, belts 2/5 and bases 2/4. Independent analytic pose, segment-distance and visibility-reachability oracles check declared and critical epochs.

nodes.label: Global AI identity namespace repair
nodes.rationale: Regression demonstrated case-variant AI base ID aliasing cluster-link ID. AiBaseGenerator now reserves/rejects base collisions with belt/cluster/link descriptors. Pre-repair binaries cannot establish final correctness.

nodes.label: Final corpus validation evidence
nodes.rationale: Dated Release Engine 1803/1803 PASS includes 4800 + 4800 + 1200 primary worlds plus repetitions, continuations and negative cases. Contracts 173, Motion 141 and Client 1755 pass. The aborted Debug run completed 1762 tests and is not a full PASS. No native FPS claim belongs here.

nodes.label: All map layers performance harness
nodes.rationale: Opt-in --solar-map --clusters --all-map-layers --seeds1:100 --scenarios all --config max reports generation/snapshot/save bytes/time, entity versus decoration counts and raster distributions with optional native reference. Missing hardware/GPU/baseline cannot be marked passed.

nodes.label: Fresh matched performance baseline
nodes.rationale: Baseline and full runs each contain 600 worlds with matched case keys and eighteen raster views. Baseline explicitly disables Environment and PoiTemplates to avoid shipped defaults. The comparison measures incremental feature cost, not a speedup. Reports include flags, clocks, backend, provenance and an optional hashed native reference.

nodes.label: Full map performance measured results
nodes.rationale: Full generation/snapshot/save medians are 44.6164/1.2844/6.51055 ms; payload is 3136968.5 bytes. Baseline medians are 23.25685/1.3491/6.40935 ms. Full worlds add exactly four entities; five fields, two POI and four territories remain metadata. Raster p99 is 7.3695–19.4668 ms and is not GPU evidence. Tooling 9/9 passed.

nodes.label: Native FPS acceptance OPEN
nodes.rationale: Implementation and measurements are complete, but 80 FPS acceptance is OPEN. All eight final scripted native interaction cases pass and screenshots were inspected. Native p99 is 50.5839–54.4007 ms against the 12.5 ms target; all eight FPS verdicts fail. Pacing diagnosis and a passing native result remain required.

nodes.label: Native measurement provenance and limitations
nodes.rationale: Each case has 120 warmup and 600 measured swap-completion intervals. Hardware: 100 Hz Intel Arc 140V, OpenGL 3.3, driver 32.0.101.8860, VSync enabled. No-new-layers baseline p99 is 53.2056 ms; empty VSync control 45.7321 ms. No-VSync control is not gameplay evidence. The failed 1 ms timer diagnostic was removed. Driver/OS cause is unproven; GPU execution, physical scanout and human playthrough remain unmeasured.

nodes.label: Native interaction repair evidence
nodes.rationale: Reproduced failures led to fixes for POI clicks consumed by aggregate LOD, automatic Follow interrupting overlap cycling, Sun/Planet marker priority, toolbar/info-panel overlap and an unreachable diagnostic close control. The close control now paints and hit-tests first. The affected eighth native case was rerun; other seven cases do not execute the changed branch after closing the panel.

nodes.label: Render no synchronous session proof
nodes.rationale: The actual renderer uses buffered map data with a throwing IGameSessionConnection over 100 frames. Decoration density must not multiply authoritative entities. Live map counts, layer flags and epochs prevent frame performance being attributed to an empty or disabled map.

nodes.label: Final render regression evidence
nodes.rationale: Dated final Release Client 1758/1758, Engine 1803/1803, Contracts 173/173, Motion 141/141 and tooling 9/9 PASS. Builds have zero warnings/errors. Native interactions cover min/max, system/belt/cluster/base/field/POI, UI 1/1.2/1.5 and 1280×720/1920×1080.

nodes.label: Documentation synchronization
nodes.rationale: Inventory all affected docs/comments against primarysource/evidence; retain datedhistory and supersession, validate links, never turn historicalmeasurements into currentproof. Documentation may proceed independently ofOPENFPS once functional/evidencepredecessor published.

nodes.label: Documentation synchronization evidence
nodes.rationale: Twenty paths were reviewed or updated: a canonical map contract, seventeen existing documentation/handoff files, and source comments without gameplay changes. Link validation covered 113 Markdown files and 264 links with zero broken links. Scoped format and diff check passed; hover-priority wording was corrected and OPEN FPS preserved.

nodes.label: Current EP4 ticket inventory
nodes.rationale: The current inventory has 9 stories and 26 tickets, superseding the dated 8-story/24-ticket plan. Functional implementation and evidence are published. The final 25 done/1 in_progress count is explicitly conditional on publishing US9 TK2; ImplementationStatus owns actual status and SHAs.

nodes.label: Async Engine Client boundary
nodes.rationale: Engine is pure .NET without graphics. Contracts has no project dependencies; Motion is shared by Engine and Client. Client uses the LocalClient adapter through IGameSessionConnection. Render reads local buffer and prediction only; future network transport must preserve the client contract.

nodes.label: Atomic snapshot clock pairing
nodes.rationale: BufferedSnapshot atomically pairs immutable snapshot and receipt timestamp. Unconfirmed commands cannot change prediction. Shared Motion gives Engine and Client the same deterministic mathematics.

nodes.label: Modal pause state machine
nodes.rationale: The first modal saves current speed and pauses the authoritative world; nested modals do not overwrite it. Closing the last modal restores the previous speed, including Speed0. UI continues and buffer CurrentSpeed gates prediction immediately after control completion.

nodes.label: EP4 architecture current state
nodes.rationale: Contracts owns AiMap DTOs, Engine owns generation/placement/strict ingress, Motion owns orbital mathematics, and Client owns presentation/descriptor selection. Content is inline, SaveFormat is 15 and AiMap rulesVersion is 1. Preserve no-effects, atomic load and distinctions between raster/native/scanout evidence.

nodes.label: Authoritative hostile docking denial
nodes.rationale: Engine rejects AI/hostile station Dock before geometry checks, including dialogue grants and forged docked state, with station_access_denied. Human docking keeps existing rules. This is access control, not combat.

nodes.label: Dock and undock state
nodes.rationale: Dock requires a Station within the configured strict range <200 km and matching speed/course. Success sets authoritative docking IDs and a (1,1) offset; it is an instant one-shot rather than ActiveCycle. Undock retains pose/speed/course and clears docking and future port fees.

nodes.label: Procedural system requirements
nodes.rationale: New games are reproducible by seed/version. Requirements include 2–5 belts, compact human clusters with 10–12 stations, and 50–75 calendar days to the Sun at starter maximum speed from every starting scenario. Map geography is fully known initially; patrols and environmental gameplay belong to later stages.

nodes.label: Calendar motion scale and start radius
nodes.rationale: There are 300 calendar seconds per motion second, and 100 m per world unit. Read Vmax from the ship. distanceWorld = Vmax × days × 86400 / 300 × 10; at 4 km/s the range is 576000–864000 world units. Use actual post-placement player pose including dock offset. Speed multipliers alter waiting time, not trip days, and upgrades do not rescale an existing map.

nodes.label: Economic cluster versus visual aggregate
nodes.rationale: A cluster has permanent domain ID, belt, membership and economic profiles, independent of screen aggregation. Five profiles include transit without production; scientific-military human stations are not AI. Economic graphs precede coordinates and require at least two cycles, two directions and backhaul. Geography does not guarantee profit.

nodes.label: Rigid orbital cluster rationale
nodes.rationale: Shared angular organization maintains compactness; independent random station periods are forbidden. The concept's short arc/common radius is a proposed initial model and precise phase extension was not an existing JSON claim. Analytic phase from epochs avoids per-frame accumulation, and calendar-period conversion by 300 preserves physical speed.

nodes.label: Informational territories and fields
nodes.rationale: Stable typed fields carry geometry/intensity and follow a parent, own orbit or static Sun anchor. Camera and decorative noise cannot alter world geometry. Overlapping bases retain separate contributions. Placement checks start networks and intercluster detours over a declared 365-day horizon; these are not autopilot, attack probabilities or perpetual safety.

nodes.label: Atomic bounded generation
nodes.rationale: Independent named streams and stable IDs prevent decoration changes from perturbing the economy. Validate configuration, graphs, geometry, time and anchors before publication. Bounded retries end with a seed/reason diagnostic rather than partial world publication.

nodes.label: Scenario and inventory preservation
nodes.rationale: The historical five-scenario table is now six with PlayerShipOnly. Translate the starting group without stretching local distances. Preserve explicit IDs, docking, crew, modules and inventory. Existing stations count within the 10–12 quota. Old fixtures and saves are not regenerated.

nodes.label: Known geography versus market knowledge
nodes.rationale: Authoritative policy opens geography from the start but does not grant remote quotes or trade, or remove mining/scanner prerequisites. World and knowledge remain separate; rendering hidden technical data is not a substitute for authoritative disclosure.

nodes.label: Save resolved world rather than seed
nodes.rationale: Persist structure, IDs, orbits, anchors, versions, both clocks and dynamic state. Seed alone cannot preserve a world after a generator change. Load does not reroll phases/names or reset markets. Old saves retain their world and unsupported versions reject before publication.

nodes.label: EP4 delivered geography current clarification
nodes.rationale: EP2/3/4 now deliver geography for six scenarios, including bases, territories, fields and POI. Old planning tables remain historical. Save15 restores descriptors without generation. Map knowledge does not reveal remote quotes or hidden survey composition. Native 80 FPS was not achieved, so AC15 is not proof of stable 80 FPS.

nodes.label: Confirmed Approach route presentation
nodes.rationale: EngineRequirements §60 defines the shortest admissible constant-speed route to a future trailing point if interception is possible, otherwise a trailing point fixed at planning time. Client draws the confirmed ApproachRoute. A fallback does not promise interception and the visual extension is outside the maneuver.

nodes.label: EP4 local descriptor navigation
nodes.rationale: System/cluster fit and four layers use one snapshot world and shared Motion mathematics. Territories and fields do not introduce maneuvers or collision rules. POI/field selection is local, overlap cycling preserves the camera and Ctrl+free click uses engine.orbit.

nodes.label: Current trading system status
nodes.rationale: EP1/3 deliver the interface, dynamic markets, production/consumption, events and trading geography. Functional delivery does not close balance acceptance.

nodes.label: Authoritative market transactions
nodes.rationale: Docked Station opens nested modal Trade, then buy/sell/refuel commands. Engine owns per-unit dynamic prices, stock/event/direction factors, finite budget and marketRevision validation. Money uses fixed-point; Client does not calculate authoritative quotes.

nodes.label: Hostile access and no economic map effects
nodes.rationale: AiEnemy stations have no human market. Engine rejects legacy/quoted trade, quote/refuel and forged quote/dock paths; DockedStationTrade is suppressed. Known geography does not permit remote quotes. Fields/territories do not alter prices, stocks, budgets, consumption or receipts.

nodes.label: GameSession current EP4 UI
nodes.rationale: AI diamond markers show owner/type, moving defence/patrol circles, Radiation/Dust/Debris and known POI. The four-layer toolbar supports cycling and compact scrolling panels. Fields state no effects and POI unavailable exploration. Access denial exists in UI and Engine. Native interaction 8/8 passes; 80 FPS remains OPEN.

nodes.label: Requirements chronology
nodes.rationale: This is a requirements checkpoint, not a claim that every section is implemented. Later explicit amendments supersede early descriptions. Sections37–41 originally took priority over older knowledge/render requirements.

nodes.label: World motion conventions
nodes.rationale: World positions use double and100m units; angles clockwise with0up. Early SpeedMps integer prose is historical relative to later Motion km/s contract. Sun stationary; kinematic centered ellipse uses constant phase speed, not Kepler acceleration.

nodes.label: Strict configuration startup
nodes.rationale: Scenario, save and snapshot reuse domain structure while serving different roles. Settings and all referenced immutable type configuration must validate before session creation; missing mandatory data or unknown fields fail, no implicit balance fallback.

nodes.label: Persisted named RNG streams
nodes.rationale: Each subsystem uses a deterministic named stream derived from UInt64 masterSeed. Save seed/counter; every draw increments10; missing stream starts10000 after1000 skipped values; invalid nonmultiple counters round up with warning. Simulation cannot use global random.

nodes.label: Render memory boundary
nodes.rationale: 80FPS is a goal of12.5ms. Render never requests Engine/network, serializes wholeJSON, waits simulation locks, or writes predicted/visual state back. Snapshot and monotonic receipt timestamp publish atomically.

nodes.label: Authoritative and prediction clocks
nodes.rationale: Section21 local baseline uses1Hz snapshots and no required100ms internal tick, which conflicts with earlier/later historical tick tables. Prediction uses last confirmed motion and monotonic elapsed time, at pause delta0. Shared Motion is pure math, not a game tick.

nodes.label: Command validation and supersession
nodes.rationale: Module-addressed objectId/moduleId commands remain unconfirmed until authoritative result. Reject does not supersede accepted pending command; execution revalidates against shared TurnStartState, deterministic conflict ordering and maximum3deferred attempts.

nodes.label: Explicit command results and ship events
nodes.rationale: Engine emits command results and stable event codes rather than requiring UI snapshot differencing. Watch log retains180000ms game-time window for player spacecraft; presentation localizes. First version assumes no ship switching.

nodes.label: New Game and scenario selection
nodes.rationale: Interactive New Game lists validated scenarios and explicitly starts selected file via factory, creates masterSeed and paused initial snapshot. Client never constructs domain objects; scenario picker is top-level, not a modal.

nodes.label: Legacy scanner knowledge
nodes.rationale: Legacy general scan exposes type, speed and mass; structural scan reveals composition, permanently per surviving ID. Already known target rejects without RNG. Structural radius120km/cycle60000ms/chance85. New map knowledge amendments do not erase legacy eligibility.

nodes.label: Legacy orbital visibility rule
nodes.rationale: Historical rendering filters hide most objects beyond Small/Combat and constrain orbits to9600world units near player/focus. EP4 final amendment replaces proximity-only orbit policy for SolarSystem strategic view.

nodes.label: World aligned adaptive grid
nodes.rationale: Client-only grid uses world-coordinate multiples and screen spacing threshold10px; pan/zoom cannot move world origin. Draw only visible lines and use cache only when computation is actually reused.

nodes.label: Authoritative knowledge label masking
nodes.rationale: Labels cannot leak hidden object ID/type/mass/speed/composition from technical payload. Known asteroid labels use IDs, stations name+ID, ships name only. Knowledge controls visible facts, not renderer access alone.

nodes.label: Module type versus instance state
nodes.rationale: Module definitions hold mass, slot size, power and maxStructure; installed instances hold IDs, On/Off, Ready/Busy/Destroyed and active cycle. Type-specific maxStructure supersedes universal100. ActivationPower is momentary power requirement, not energy.

nodes.label: Historical platform damage model
nodes.rationale: Platform geometry and weighted damage allocation are retained historical intent. Section57 replaces platform placement with hull grid; platform damage needs its own revision and must not be inferred as delivered runtime.

nodes.label: Ship energy and fuel separation
nodes.rationale: PowerW differs from storedWh. Generators consume cargo Energy Cells using rational/integer accumulator; batteries cover deficit then deterministic emergency module shutdown. Ordinary Busy shutdown denied but power loss aborts without effect. Engine later uses tank fuel instead.

nodes.label: Modal authoritative pause
nodes.rationale: All single-player modals pause actual world, clocks, cycles and RNG while transport/input/render continue. Depth0→1 saves speed, final1→0 restores it includingSpeed0. Dispose ends session; cancellation is not temporary pause. Prediction delta remains0.

nodes.label: Diagnostic panel and object selection history
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic panel is local, screen anchored, dismissible X and Ctrl+I. Later54.9 supersedes placeholder selected/active fields:30px type-priority hit tests, distance then Ordinal ID. EP4 cycling further refines click selection while hover remains noncyclic.

nodes.label: ECS internal authority boundary
nodes.rationale: ECS is Engine implementation detail; stable objectId/moduleId bridge internal entity IDs. Contracts, Motion and Client must not expose ECS types or mutable internals. Domain data+systems replace deep inheritance.

nodes.label: Immutable registries and compact runtime references
nodes.rationale: Immutable type definitions/recipes stay in registries; runtime has live values and IDs, hot paths may resolve compact index. Save source is typeId, not index. Load validates references and instance state before construction; snapshot is projection, not second source.

nodes.label: Atomic resources and deterministic factory order
nodes.rationale: Factory Idle→Loading→Working→Unloading consumes all inputs atomically, preserves pending output and overflow time; no next cycle before unloading. Stable owner/instance ordering resolves shared pools. Ship cargo retains physical module distribution; aggregated availability is computed.

nodes.label: Deterministic system ordering
nodes.rationale: Systems, conflict rules, shared resources, entity order, RNG and events require stable keys. Parallel calculations need deterministic collect-sort-apply. Save/load rebuild may change internal IDs but must retain domain results; never expose half-applied structural changes.

nodes.label: ECS adoption is an unimplemented choice
nodes.rationale: Arch is a preferred candidate for a future spike, not an already adopted requirement. Domain contracts and deterministic save behavior precede library adoption and tuning. Global state, RNG registry, UI, heavy variable collections and immutable type data are not default ECS entities.

nodes.label: Fixed point active command factors
nodes.rationale: First iteration narrows scope to ships/modules. Command time/complexity/consumption factors normalize1000=1; missing factor1, zero allowed. Effective duration/activation cost ceil; evenzero-duration creates cycle finishing next tick. Consumed activation resources not refunded on interruption.

nodes.label: Stable command outcome and cycle identity
nodes.rationale: Success roll occurs at completion in stable object/module/cycle order using named persisted stream. ActiveCycle IDs and allocators persist; frozen IDs never renamed with content. Interrupted cycles apply no effect, consume no refund and emit machine-readable event.

nodes.label: Engine fuel supersedes Energy Cells
nodes.rationale: Engine fuel is integer kilograms inside module tank, never cargo or ItemType mass. Explicit starter fuel750/1000; omitted scenario amount historically defaults full. Earlier Engine Energy Cells description is superseded.

nodes.label: Tetrarch hull grid
nodes.rationale: HullLayout width/height/cells and moduleOccupiedCells replace platform geometry. Cells must be in hull and disjoint, count matches slot size. Tetrarch9x9 has12 structural cells,8modules and4free; module types excluded from starter remain in catalogue.

nodes.label: Docking MVP historical execution
nodes.rationale: Instant navigation.dock command validates target/range/synchronization, persists docking fields and opens Station only after snapshot result. This dated section says Undock unavailable; current Docking.md explicitly implements it, so historical MVP text cannot determine current runtime.

nodes.label: Trading unit supersession
nodes.rationale: 2026-09-18 amendment replaces100/10kg packages with one catalogue trade unit. Currency uses fixed-point with AwayFromZero rounding; explicit starter inventory overrides fallback. Earlier economics status is dated and later Trading.md reports implemented EP1/3.

nodes.label: Approach planner version 3
nodes.rationale: Constant-speed shortest route among six Dubins families; earliest reachable future trailing point or shortest fixed trailing point if no intercept. Target speed alone does not determine reachability. Shared immutable route executes/predicts; older route versions replan at cycle boundary without pose jump. No obstacle avoidance.

nodes.label: Countermeasure combat historical version
nodes.rationale: EP7 adds separate operators, frozen ratings/chances, physical-time guided/coast/reload, deterministic contact roll and persisted journal/RNG. Defence metadata version1 and then SaveFormat11 are dated historical contracts; EP4 final Save15 supersedes current save number without removing combat state.

nodes.label: Current EP4 requirements amendment
nodes.rationale: Engine owns materialized AiMap rules1 and atomicSave15. Hostile stations deny dock/dialogue/trade/quote/refuel withstation_access_denied. Informational territories/fields/POI cause no damage,fuel,economy,RNG or motion effects.365day local checks and declared/critical intercluster epochs are finite. Strategic known-map visibility replaces proximity-only; descriptor selection/cycling refines nearest-only, hover retains priority/distance/ordinal.

nodes.label: Load screen and current AiMap restoration
Save screen and current AiMap persistence
Current EP-0004 AI map environment contract and evidence
Save15 loads materialized AiMap atomically without regeneration
nodes.rationale: Validate version, finite geometry, parent references and shared case-insensitive ID namespace before replacing world. Legacy absence stays null; actual file Load starts paused and preserves trading continuation.

nodes.label: Save15 persists AiMap rulesVersion1 and both time epochs
nodes.rationale: Persist bases, radii, field geometry/anchors/seeds and POI text/anchors. Later content changes do not change loaded map. Earlier Save11 paragraph is historical EP7.

nodes.label: Load uses session boundary and modal pause
nodes.rationale: Client does not directly mutate authoritative state. Restore stocks, budgets, revisions, events, seed and trading network without repeating intervals or receipts.

nodes.label: Save screen selects New Save or Overwrite from entered name
nodes.rationale: Single content panel, persistent name field, dynamic bottom action; matching existing name selects and scrolls its slot, success closes window.

nodes.label: Client-visible rendering metadata and graphics-free Engine
nodes.rationale: Contracts carry dependency-free IDs, serializable metadata and session control; color mapping is centralized in Client.

nodes.label: Scan knowledge changes projection without changing domain type
nodes.rationale: Unknown NPC relation falls back to neutral; unknown objects use fallback until GeneralScan; client color cannot expose forbidden factual state.

nodes.label: Approach draws confirmed remaining route and exact terminal pose
nodes.rationale: IsRendezvous decides meeting; fixed rear-point fallback and viewport course extension do not promise pursuit. Render loop never requests Engine.

nodes.label: Stable overlap selection uses object priority and repeated clicks
nodes.rationale: Stations, player, NPC, other real objects, POI, fields; distance and ordinal ID within groups. Repeated click within3 raw px cycles. Real hit radius30px, POI15px, fields geometry; free drag pans and Ctrl-free sends engine.orbit.

nodes.label: AiMap exposes four independent default-on map layers
nodes.rationale: Hidden descriptors cannot be selected; SelectedFieldId/SelectedPoiId remain Client-local with panel priority and unavailable target commands. Diagnostic X draws last and hit-tests first. Native interaction checked while FPS remains OPEN.

nodes.label: AiMapEnvironmentSnapshot rulesVersion1 is optional authoritative state
nodes.rationale: Engine creates materialized Bases, Territories, Fields and PointsOfInterest; Client reads SnapshotBuffer and shares Motion math. 100m/world unit, radii km×10, calendar orbital period and physical epoch; Speed1 calendar ratio300.

nodes.label: AI bases are known hostile Station objects with one orbital anchor
nodes.rationale: Owner AiEnemy on real object and Ai on descriptor; Planetary follows parent plus offset, Orbital owns orbit. Bases never join human clusters or human markets/production/inventory.

nodes.label: Territory radii follow bases and do not implement combat effects
nodes.rationale: Stable BaseObjectId reference, finite 0<defence<=patrol; overlaps do not add fill intensity. Selected territory highlights outline; patrols, damage, combat and diplomacy out of scope.

nodes.label: Radiation Dust Debris are informational anchored descriptors
nodes.rationale: Intensity0..1, inner<outer, sweep0..360 clockwise from up. Parent/Orbit/Sun mutually exclusive; Sun can anchor static Dust sector. DecorationSeed changes illustration only; descriptor cycles forbidden.

nodes.label: Known POI are metadata rather than SpaceObject or rewards
nodes.rationale: ObjectId/name/description plus parent-or-orbit offset. Prefer canonical resource asteroids, otherwise orbit in belt; no Engine actions.

nodes.label: New Game generates solar clusters AI fields POI in fixed sequence
nodes.rationale: Independent named seeded streams and ordinal templates; stable SYS IDs; ready world publishes atomically. Shipped AI2..4, radii200/1000km, attempts64; field counts1/2/2; two POI templates embedded in solar-system.json, no separate template file.

nodes.label: Placement protects human trade geography over bounded epochs
nodes.rationale: Player only at start; stations/local segments checked throughout365 days with conservative recursive distance bounds and failure on uncertainty. Intercluster visibility graph checked at declared/critical epochs within system and outside sun exclusion; continuous intercluster safety and infinite horizon not proved.

nodes.label: Engine rejects hostile docking quotes trade and refuel
nodes.rationale: station_access_denied covers dialogue grants and forged dock/quote paths; DockedStationTrade absent. Disabled UI alone is insufficient. Open spatial knowledge does not grant remote quotes or bypass scans.

nodes.rationale: Current AiMap rulesVersion1; no regeneration from content; legacy null remains null. Objects/belts/clusters/links/territories/fields/POI share case-insensitive uniqueness. Loaded informational overlap/radii do not rerun New Game placement proof.

nodes.rationale: New toolbar second row only with AiMap; legacy eight buttons retained. Hidden layer removes descriptor hit-test and selection without changing world, quote or real selection.

nodes.rationale: Priority/distance/ordinal cycling includes descriptors; panel selection outranks hover. Selected fields warn of no gameplay effects, POI of no exploration. Both enabled-state and dispatch reject target module commands.

nodes.rationale: Debris uses cached local LCG samples, not Engine RNG/entities. Compact info scroll consumes wheel and reserves toolbar space. Diagnostic X top priority. Extreme projected radii over1e8px may omit territory edge for numeric stability.

nodes.rationale: Sequential600+600 worlds,18+18 raster views. Full medians generation44.6164ms snapshot1.2844ms save6.51055ms; raster p997.3695..19.4668ms; matched full worlds add exactly4 AI entities. No speedup claimed.

GPU execution/scanout unmeasured; human playthrough NOT RUN. Seven cases precede final Diagnostic X fix, affected eighth rerun; raw hashes retained after artifact cleanup.

nodes.rationale: Shared Motion math, preserved starts across six scenarios, rigid resource transform, real orbital station visits with constant Approach speed and explicit synchronization.

nodes.rationale: Parent station orbit saved; docked offset reconstructed; real SaveAsync/factory roundtrip with controlled clock, no regeneration and atomic invalid-load handling. Current EP4 uses later Save15.

nodes.rationale: Restricted execution had swap delay while host controls were faster; historical maximum p9911.379ms does not establish current full-map acceptance.

nodes.rationale: EP4 adds AI, fields, POI and persistence/selection integration; current native80FPS acceptance explicitly OPEN.

nodes.label: EP7 graph artifacts are historical and absent from current checkout
nodes.rationale: Old src/graphify-out artifacts describe619 files from2026-10-04. Current EP4 root graph replaces them; navigation graph does not prove gameplay acceptance.

nodes.label: Graph extraction preserves unresolved reference and AST-stub warnings
nodes.rationale: Placeholders are not verified code declarations. Undirected graph merges pairwise references/calls; contains/documents mean navigation, not runtime calls. HTML shows260 historical communities, JSON retains symbols.

nodes.label: Graph token usage is unknown; template zeros are placeholders
nodes.rationale: No agent usage returned; cost.json uses null. Heuristic benchmark29.5x is graph-derived estimate rather than measured agent usage.

nodes.label: Documentation distinguishes requirements current contracts and dated evidence
nodes.rationale: Use closest existing document; requirements own behavior, backlog is historical and not active source-of-truth, measurements belong in engineering. EP4 links open FPS acceptance; predecessor evidence is dated.

nodes.label: Canonical resource asteroid IDs and EP1 economy remain one source
nodes.rationale: Rigid group/resource distances and disjoint annuli verified; no duplicate field inventory or automatic resource production. Live estimates use authoritative max speed and physical sample epoch; remote quotes remain unavailable.

nodes.label: EP3 real file continuation preserves graph economy and durable receipts
nodes.rationale: Invalid membership/profile/belt/link/resource refs reject before publication; LocalClient completes same return commands with single Buy posting. Optional clusterMap did not independently change save version; ephemeral quote IDs excluded from state equivalence.

nodes.label: Final EP3 starter efficiency is200km/kg after failed interim100
nodes.rationale: All six seed/config cases complete148..153day returns with matching hashes and visible losses. Authoritative capacity doubled for cargo upgrade; analytical multiplier must not apply twice.

nodes.label: Historical EP3 five native cases passed at60 stations
nodes.rationale: 4800-world corpus,18 raster views and five real native cases. All60 station selections each case; rendering fixes bounded huge orbit arcs and indexed frame lookups. Native input scripted, human playthrough and profitability unassessed.

nodes.label: EP3 supplies persisted human geography to EP4
nodes.rationale: Cluster IDs, belts, home district, rigid orbits, live bounds, local links, intercluster directions and resources retained. Historical EP3 FPS is not current EP4 full-map result; new matched report measures added cost and native target failed.

nodes.label: Window probe renders one snapshot without Engine or replay stream
nodes.rationale: Production GPU options with explicit swap timing; optional no-vsync sleep and glFinish diagnostic alter cadence and cannot represent game throughput.

nodes.label: Native target uses completed swap p99 not CPU or GPU execution time
nodes.rationale: p99>12.5ms fails; VSync refresh below80Hz is display-limited. Measurement completion does not mean FPS target passed; physical scanout/GPU execution not directly measured.

nodes.label: Full-map harness uses matched flags and actual input handlers
nodes.rationale: Absolute paths required because runner changes asset cwd; all layers require clusters. Baseline omits all-map-layers and boundary-only matches counts. Native min3x10/2AI max5x12/4AI, eight final views/scales; exit0 means interaction/report complete, not80FPS.

nodes.label: Current full-map native8 interactions pass and0 FPS cases pass
nodes.rationale: VSync reported100Hz Intel Arc140V; p9950.5839..54.4007ms. Baseline and empty controls fail too; driver/OS cause unproven. Raw native artifacts removed after review; compact provenance retained.
